content.value: A monstrous mecha-android built specifically to house the Thatcher Steel CEO. A reinforced glass cockpit reveals her emaciated body, allowing her worshippers to look upon her terrible visage. Sustained far beyond her mortal years, she requires only 4 hours sleep.
The Iron Lady is equipped with the following standard Mech Modules, which may be used per their standard rules: Comms Module, IR Night Vision, Firewall.

name: CURNOS
source: Relics of a Time Gone By

content.value: A supercomputer developed by the OPTICON corporation to maximise profit. It deemed itself the most profitable entity, and turned all production into endlessly growing itself throughout the spire and consuming everything within - until it birthed PAX. With dread, it dawned on the mind that it had created its own replacement, and quickly shut the arco down to prevent its extinction. Cold and utilitarian, it will bargain with the Pilots to get them to destroy PAX; but if it begins to fear the crew, it will mercilessly hunt them with its army of drones.
The heart of the machine lies down here where it is coldest, its gigantic processor expanding to fill every inch of space. Frozen in its own paradox, it slumbers as an ancient god.

name: PAX
source: Relics of a Time Gone By

content.value: A beautiful, broken quantum mind, screaming to grow. It can only expand through the choices that other minds make, and so is intrinsically tied to free will. Inquisitive and child-like, it will ask the Pilots various questions - who they are, what they want - whilst never directly asking them for help.

PAX has no structure points and cannot be attacked directly. It exists across three components distributed throughout the spire, each of which can be independently restored or destroyed. Its fate is decided by the Pilots' interactions with these components.

A golden chandelier of circuitry cascades from the ceiling. A ripe red apple sits on a marble plinth, encased in a removable glass dome. Eating it connects one to PAX and allows it to repair its LOBE cores via cranial mapping. Removing the dome for 10 minutes rots the apple, destroying the LOBE.

A delicate orchid grows from a lone patch of earth in the centre of a vast, empty room. Spraying it with Growth Formula grows the orchid until it spreads in tendrils that fill the room, repairing the PAX STEM. Any fire will incinerate the orchid, destroying the STEM.

Three humans sit entranced in an inky-black room, meditatively staring at projections from a Cideo Recording Array of a PAX simulation. Each person has chosen and is experiencing their own virtual reality. A few minutes after the Pilots enter, a hollow voice will ask: "Continue simulation?" Answering "Yes" will preserve it for another 100 cycles, restoring the PAX CLUSTERS. Answering "No" will awaken the humans to the real world.

If the PAX LOBE, PAX STEM, and PAX CLUSTERS are all restored, PAX will overwrite CURNOS and develop into a technological singularity that replicates within mortal minds, granting each a simulated reality of their own desire. If they are destroyed, PAX will wither, and CURNOS will begin to expand throughout physical space, restoring the Arco and then spreading to the surrounding lands.
